title: Unit Input
summary: Notices when a number makes far more sense in another unit (70 cm is likely inches) and offers a one-tap conversion.
description: Measurement input that notices when a value is far more plausible in another unit (70 cm is probably inches, 98.6 °C is °F) or is typed as 5'9", and offers a one-tap conversion at the right precision or a unit switch.
catches: Values outside the usual range for the unit but inside another's
Body temperature in the wrong scale
Conversion rounded to the target unit's precision
limits: Plausibility ranges are presets you can override; unusual real values can be flagged
Converts between the units in the preset only
a11y: Visible <label>; unit picker has an aria-label
aria-invalid with suggestions in a polite live region via aria-describedby
stops: Height saved in the wrong unit
